selectCompanyToViewProjects: Select a company to view projects.
repoUrlTooltip: Link a GitHub repository so agents can clone, read, and push code for this project.
localFolderTooltip: Set an absolute path on this machine where local agents will read and write files for this project.
localFolderMustBeAbsolute: Local folder must be a full absolute path.
repoMustBeValidUrl: Repo must use a valid GitHub or GitHub Enterprise repo URL.
projectWorkspaceDescription: Configure the concrete workspace Paperclip attaches to this project. These values drive per-workspace checkout behavior, default runtime services for child execution workspaces, and let you override setup or cleanup commands when one workspace needs special handling.
primaryWorkspaceNotice: This is the project's primary codebase workspace.
sourceTypeLocalGitDescription: A local path Paperclip can use directly.
sourceTypeNonGitDescription: A local folder without git semantics.
sourceTypeGitRepoDescription: A repo URL with optional refs and local checkout.
sourceTypeRemoteManagedDescription: A hosted workspace tracked by external reference.
setupCommandHint: Runs when this workspace needs custom bootstrap
cleanupCommandHint: Runs before project-level execution workspace teardown
runtimeServicesJsonHint: Default runtime services for this workspace. Execution workspaces inherit this config unless they set an override. If you do not know the commands yet, ask your CEO to configure them for you.
workspaceNotFound: Workspace not found for this project.
runtimeServicesSharedDescription: Shared services for this project workspace. Execution workspaces inherit this config unless they override it.
noRuntimeServicesRunning: No runtime services are currently running for this workspace.
noRuntimeServiceConfigured: No runtime-service default is configured for this workspace yet.
executionWorkspaceDescription: Configure the concrete runtime workspace that Paperclip reuses for this issue flow. These settings stay attached to the execution workspace so future runs can keep local paths, repo refs, provisioning, teardown, and runtime-service behavior in sync with the actual workspace being reused.
provisionCommandHint: Runs when Paperclip prepares this execution workspace
teardownCommandHint: Runs when the execution workspace is archived or cleaned up
runtimeConfigOverride: This execution workspace currently overrides the project workspace runtime config.
runtimeConfigInherited: This execution workspace is inheriting the project workspace runtime config.
runtimeConfigNone: No runtime config is currently defined on this execution workspace or its project workspace.
runtimeServicesJsonExecHint: Concrete workspace runtime settings for this execution workspace. Leave this inheriting unless you need a one-off override. If you are missing the right commands, ask your CEO to set them up for you.
noRuntimeServicesRunningExec: No runtime services are currently running for this execution workspace.
noRuntimeConfigDefinedExec: No runtime config is defined for this execution workspace yet.
noWorkspaceOperationsRecorded: No workspace operations have been recorded yet.
issuesUsingThisWorkspaceDescription: Any issue attached to this execution workspace appears here so you can review the full session context before reusing or closing it.
noIssuesLinked: No issues are currently linked to this execution workspace.
closeWorkspaceDialogDescription: Archive <1>{{name}}</1> and clean up any owned workspace artifacts. Paperclip keeps the workspace record and issue history, but removes it from active workspace views.
checkingSafeToClose: Checking whether this workspace is safe to close...
failedToInspectReadiness: Failed to inspect workspace close readiness.
sharedWorkspaceNote: This is a shared workspace session. Archiving it removes this session record but keeps the underlying project workspace.
ownCheckoutPathNote: This execution workspace has its own checkout path and can be archived independently.
primaryWorkspacePathNote: This execution workspace currently points at the project's primary workspace path.
disposableWorkspaceNote: This workspace is disposable and can be archived.
cleanupPreviouslyFailed: Cleanup previously failed on this workspace. Retrying close will rerun the cleanup flow and update the workspace status if it succeeds.
codebaseTooltip: Repo identifies the source of truth. Local folder is the default place agents write code.
additionalLegacyWorkspaces: Additional legacy workspace records exist on this project. Paperclip is using the primary workspace as the codebase view.
clearLocalFolderConfirm: Clear local folder from this workspace?
localFolderAbsoluteError: Local folder must be a full absolute path.
repoValidUrlError: Repo must use a valid GitHub or GitHub Enterprise repo URL.
executionWorkspacesTooltip: Project-owned defaults for isolated issue checkouts and execution workspace behavior.
enableIsolatedCheckoutsDescription: Let issues choose between the project's primary checkout and an isolated execution workspace.
newIssuesDefaultIsolated: New issues default to isolated checkout
newIssuesDefaultIsolatedDescription: If disabled, new issues stay on the project's primary checkout unless someone opts in.
provisionTeardownHint: Provision runs inside the derived worktree before agent execution. Teardown is stored here for future cleanup flows.
archiveDescription: Archive this project to hide it from the sidebar and project selectors.
unarchiveDescription: Unarchive this project to restore it in the sidebar and project selectors.
validationRemoteManagedRequiresRef: Remote-managed workspaces require a remote workspace ref or repo URL.
validationWorkspaceRequiresPathOrUrl: Workspace requires at least one local path or repo URL.
validationLocalPathMustBeAbsolute: Local workspace path must be absolute.
validationRepoUrlMustBeValid: Repo URL must be a valid URL.
validationRuntimeJsonMustBeObject: Runtime services JSON must be a JSON object.
validationWorkspaceRuntimeJsonMustBeObje: Workspace runtime JSON must be a JSON object.
